steps.question: How big are icons next to text?
steps.why: Larger icons hold their own next to big type.

steps.question: What icon style and stroke?
steps.why: Contained icons sit in a tinted shape at a 1.75px stroke, so they carry the brand's warmth.

steps.use: Not used: always add a word
steps.not: an icon button with a hover hint
steps.why: On phones, hover hints never show; a word says what will happen.

steps.question: How fast does feedback feel?
steps.why: Feedback stays fast; the personality shows in panels and hero moments, which move slower on a spring.
Motion is part of the brand, so it shrinks to a fade instead of vanishing. Full motion is never forced on people who asked for less.
